mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) by more than 0.5% month-over-month signals inflationary pressure, leading to a tightening monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are positive in more than 40% of the instances where CPIAUCSL increases by more than 0.5% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.2 percentage points month-over-month signals a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 60% of the instances where UNRATE decreases by more than 0.2pp MoM.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% month-over-month signals a strengthening demand in the housing market, which is a leading indicator of economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 50% of the instances where HOUST increases by more than 5% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 0.5% month-over-month signals increased economic activity and supply, which leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 50% of the instances where INDPRO increases by more than 0.5% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 0.3% month-over-month, it signals a tightening monetary policy with inflationary pressure, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are positive in more than 40% of the instances where FEDFUNDS > 2% and CPIAUCSL increases by more than 0.3% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 over the previous month signals a strong labor market, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 60% of the instances where PAYEMS increases by more than 200,000.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) increase by more than 0.5% month-over-month and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.2 percentage points, it signals a strong consumer demand coupled with a tightening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increase > 0.5% MoM and UNRATE decrease > 0.2pp MoM
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 50% of the instances where RSAFS increases by more than 0.5% MoM and UNRATE decreases by more than 0.2pp MoM.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.25 percentage points within a month signals an easing monetary policy, which reduces borrowing costs and boosts equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 60% of the instances where FEDFUNDS decreases by more than 0.25pp MoM.
